acquisition_rule: first N complete TRAIN scenarios in observed archive order; choose N=10 or N=20 before acquisition; completeness only, never performance

split.rule: sorted unique canonical town/scenario IDs -> numpy PCG64(seed).permutation(N); first max(1, round(0.25*N)) -> CAL_NORMAL; remaining -> FIT_NORMAL; Python round uses ties-to-even

pseudo.fit_pseudo_use: graph training only; never one-class fitting

calibration.invalid_probability_and_uq: null in scientific handoff; raw scores retained; diagnostics separately flagged
calibration.class_balance: record counts per agent and sampling rule; freeze before fitting

artifact_schema.scenario_dictionary: canonical IDs, town, source_split and partition
manifest: normality fit parameters or separate fitted artifact
calibration parameters and complete validity audit
artifact_schema.target_scope_note: Per-agent labels apply to the corrupted modality; graph any-pseudo target is distinct and never physical safety.

kaggle_workflow: load compact artifact and verify hashes/schema
construct graph samples; keep whole scenarios in their fixed partition
train StandardGAT on FIT-derived examples only
train EpistemicGAT on identical FIT samples and paired seeds
save per-seed metrics and row-keyed predictions
graph_validation: If needed, pre-register a scenario-level validation subset within FIT before graph training. CAL is reserved for probability calibration. No hyperparameter selection on the frozen two-scenario diagnostic study.
